events.source_quote: Rawalpindi – 14 October 2021: The Chief of Army Staff (COAS), General Qamar Javed Bajwa, today visited the Army Air Defence Centre, Karachi, where a new High to Medium Air Defence System (HIMADS), reportedly the HQ-9/P, was formally inducted into service with a Pakistan Army Air Defence (PAAD) unit.
